name: laya-router
description: Rates each prompt with a local laya-serve, names a model tier, fills it in on Agent calls and can route the main loop.

route.title: Route the main loop
route.description: Route easy Opus turns to Sonnet (rewrites prompt cache on switch).

routeMaxMessages.title: Route only up to this many messages
routeMaxMessages.description: Stop routing past this message count to avoid rewriting a large cache.

lowerEffort.title: Lower effort on easy turns
lowerEffort.description: Lower main-loop effort on easy/trivial turns when per_turn_effort is enabled (no cache rewrite).

holdout.title: Holdout share
holdout.description: Fraction (0-1) of rated prompts run untouched for A/B comparison in /laya.
